notes.title: COMING AUGUST 1ST: Winter Heat Kickstarter Campaign!
notes.content:
[p][b]Coming to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Kickstarter[/url] on August 1st![/b][/p][p][b][i]Winter Heat[/i][/b] [b]is more than a love story. It’s the texts, notes, games, and digital worlds of a couple across years of their lives.[/b] This wholesome visual novel chronicles a modern romance in a uniquely digital way.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat"][/dynamiclink]Javiera Vera is a freelancer living in the sweltering summer of Maipú, Santiago, in Chile. Fukkoshi Shio is an office worker living in the snowy rural town of Miyazu, Kyoto, in Japan. Though they live on different sides of the world, they share something that transcends all boundaries: an internet connection.[/p][p][b]How will their friendship deepen during one special December? Find out through the apps Javi and Shio use every day.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/5648a0b293f3a94e2e279c9fc28620a34d607737.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re raising finishing funds for [i]Winter Heat[/i] to help expand the game further and further. Not only will we have an extensive main story, but we’ll also have a boatload of in-story “apps.” Some are educational, some flesh out the characters, some are even full-fledged minigames.[/p][p]More Kickstarter backers means more in-universe apps to explore and even more content for the main storyline. Back the campaign to follow our progress…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/df1176ca6d6703cd3c29633b4d6ccb9f485b2c21.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]…and let Javi and Shio’s story unfold.[/p][h3][b]Digital Love with Digital Apps[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/40a688196b5171ee99c19b133b0dc2b4d1a19fd5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/42bc29eedbee022c4951d3cb60f6fc08e024c951.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the classic late 00s browser-based kid-friendly MMO [b]Froguelike[/b] in special flashback chapters \[Game not actually playable]! See how Javi and Shio first met as young teens, and how they reunited after many years apart.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545287/4c6ed99f28686afbfb8870c0d16e0da6792e83dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Learn more about Javi and Shio’s towns through the [b]Maps[/b] app. Find out the best spots in Kyoto and Santiago, the local haunts, and plan your inevitable Yuri Tourism trip.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/a24a24d98d1d2ecc5b513d507433f0f4dbd9e14d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With the [b]Wittier[/b] app, find Javi and Shio online—along with trolls and other weird strangers. Then smash keywords together to post engagement bait. Can you rack up 10,000 followers?[/p][p]We’re working on many more apps as well, and with your crowdfunding support, we can make them better and better. And, with stretch goals, we’ll even add brand-new apps![/p][h3][b][i]Welcome to Oomfie RPG[/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/786ea3c062d97f2f4521a0f8dd77394ab1b93c3c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But of course, our most important app is a full-fledged sub-game: [b]Oomfie RPG![/b][/p][p]Each copy of [i]Winter Heat[/i] comes with a ROM of one of Javi and Shio’s favorite nostalgic games (and pieces of riffing material): [i]Oomfie World IV: The 1994 Saga of Turbo[/i]. Why does the title include “1994”? We’re not sure. Probably because that sounded futuristic in 1993.[/p][p]After her best friend Sam is sucked into the hot new game console, Oomfie must traverse the digital world of Turbo and collect pieces of the Virtual Cuboid Console to send them both back.[/p][p]Discover a comfy town and four mazelike adventure zones, switching from a classic overhead view to first-person face-offs in the Chili Forest and other whimsical locales.[/p][p][b]Every run through an adventure zone is different, with its own special events.[/b] Meet friends and not-so-friends on the road, and decide whether to trade, help, or run away really fast. The further you go, the more forks in the road.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45162870/435287335654a7682c77d2c7d89e660281e654b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Then oomf your way through tricky turn-based batles.[/b] Use Action Points to attack, but watch out: your AP is also your health! Healing at the right moments and reading your opponents’ moves are the keys to victory.[/p][p]You have space for eight moves…and items. Together. Will you pick up a weapon, or a healing hamburger? [b]Make tough choices on the road,[/b] and pray that the merchant has a good selection.[/p][p]Only your customized Oomfie can beat all four adventure zones and save the day![/p][h3][b]And You’ve Gotta Help![/b][/h3][p]Oomfie is counting on you to support [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]our Kickstarter when it launches on [/url][b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]August 1st[/url][/b]! We’ll also be launching a [b]brand-new demo[/b] on Steam and Itch so you can try out the new apps and the Oomfie RPG.[/p][p]We’re overjoyed to show the world this game that’s so close to our hearts.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Kickstarter link:[/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Steam link:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat"][/dynamiclink]Itch link:[/p][p][url="https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat"]https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Press kit:[/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/"]https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Visit our site:[/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com"]https://yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Follow on Bluesky:[/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Subscribe on Youtube:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yurikissaten"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Support on Patreon:[/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten"]https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan - Our New Free Game
notes.content: [p]Please check out [i]Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan[/i], Yuri Kissaten new FREE game. It's a short but powerful experience about important real-life issues in modern-day Japan, so please set aside 30 or 40 minutes to play it.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554600/Life_of_a_Dispatch_English_Teacher_in_Japan/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can learn more about the game by visiting its [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fyurikissaten.com%2Flife-of-a-dispatch-english-teacher-in-japan-press-kit%2F"]press kit page[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]It may be an emotionally heavy game, but Yuri Kissaten also has plenty of much lighter, much cuter projects coming up in the extremely near future--stay tuned for those. In particular, our Kickstarter crowdfunding [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fthedude3445%2Fwinter-heat-yuri-visual-novel%2F"]campaign for Winter Heat[/url] is drawing very near...![/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy [i]Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan [/i]and all of Yuri Kissaten's upcoming summer events.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay in touch with Yuri Kissaten all across the internet:[/p][p][/p][p]Visit the site: [/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com"]https://yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow on Bluesky: [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Subscribe on Youtube: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yurikissaten"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Support on Patreon: [/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten"]https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Happy Yuri Day from Yuri Kissaten!
notes.content: [p]Happy Yuri Day from Yuri Kissaten! We're making so many Yuri games, and you should celebrate by checking out our games and wishlisting the upcoming ones! :3c You should also check all the great Yuri games recommended by the great Steam curator [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6864182-Hella-Yuri/"]Hella Yuri[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170800/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554600/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503300/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And of course, check our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel/"]Winter Heat's Kickstarter pre-launch page[/url], but we'll be sending out a cross-promotion news update about it soon. We'll also keep sharing lots of news for [i]Ryugaku Ren'ai[/i] over the next two years before its release, so make sure to follow this game and keep getting updates.[/p]
